test_title: PYST 23: RRB Group D - GA (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which book, launched by Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan at the World Book Fair 2025, is part of the PM YUVA 2.0 scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Indian Renaissance: The Modi Decade**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian Renaissance: The Modi Decade** was launched by Union Minister **Dharmendra Pradhan** at the **World Book Fair 2025** in New Delhi as part of the **PM YUVA 2.0 scheme**.
 
• The book encapsulates the journey of **India's progress under Prime Minister Narendra Modi** during the last decade, highlighting key reforms and achievements across various sectors.
 
• The **PM YUVA 2.0 scheme** is an initiative aimed at promoting young writers and intellectuals, encouraging them to contribute to literature and national discourse.
 
• This book serves as a narrative of **India's transformation** in areas such as governance, digital infrastructure, economic development, and global stature under the leadership of PM Modi.
 
• The launch of this book reflects the government’s intent to foster an environment of intellectual engagement and literary contribution among the youth of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **PM YUVA 2.0 Scheme:**

 
 
• The **Prime Minister’s YUVA (Young, Upcoming, Versatile Authors) scheme** was initially launched in 2021 and extended to encourage **young writers below the age of 30**.
 
• The scheme aims to create a pool of authors in Indian languages and English, representing **India's rich culture, history, and traditions**.
 
• Selected young writers receive mentorship and are provided a **financial grant** to produce high-quality work.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the **National Book Trust (NBT)**, and manuscripts are published under the NBT imprint.
 
 
 
• **World Book Fair:**
 
 
• The **World Book Fair** is an annual event held in New Delhi, showcasing literary works from across India and the world.
 
• It serves as a platform for publishers, authors, and readers to engage with contemporary and classical literature.
 
• The 2025 World Book Fair focused on themes such as **literature, innovation, and India's cultural heritage.**
 
 
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan:**
 
 
• **Dharmendra Pradhan**, the Union Minister for Education, Skill Development, and Entrepreneurship, is actively involved in promoting literary and educational initiatives.
 
• He has been instrumental in implementing several schemes aimed at enhancing skill development and fostering intellectual discourse.
 
 
 
• **Achievements under Modi Decade:**
 
 
• Major reforms such as the **Goods and Services Tax (GST)**, **Digital India**, **Jan Dhan Yojana**, and **Make in India** have reshaped India's economic and global landscape.
 
• India's improved ranking in indices like the **Ease of Doing Business** and its emergence as the **5th largest economy** reflect the progress made during this period.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Options Explained:**

 
 
• **Death of a Gentleman:** This book primarily discusses cricket and its evolving dynamics. It is unrelated to the PM YUVA 2.0 scheme or the World Book Fair.
 
• **The Saga of Kudopali:** A fictional or regional narrative, not linked to the PM YUVA scheme or reforms under PM Modi.
 
• **The Elsewhereans:** Focuses on philosophical or speculative fiction and does not align with the theme of India's achievements under PM Modi.
 
 
 
• **Relevance of PM YUVA 2.0:**
 
 
• The scheme promotes intellectual growth and provides avenues for young authors to contribute to national and global literature.
 
• Books like **Indian Renaissance: The Modi Decade** are integral to showcasing India's progress and inspiring future generations.
